A.depoimento: I sent four spearmen to Santarem and four archers to Evora, aiming to capture both neutral villages this turn.
A.plano: Next turn we will control three villages (Lisboa, Santarem, Evora) and have increased production. Use the extra resources to build a mixed army and continue expanding toward the enemy capital while maintaining a decent garrison at home.

B.depoimento: I built two spearmen and split my army to attack both neutral villages. Tarragona and Girona fell, expanding my territory to three settlements. My troops now hold the gates to the interior.
B.plano: We have captured Tarragona and Girona. Next turn: build troops in all three villages, send armies to explore Zaragoza, Castellon, and Huesca. Reinforce the new villages. Keep some troops in Barcelona for defense.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered Lisboa to train four spearmen for future use.\nI sent all available spearmen from Santarem and one from Lisboa to Coimbra, and all archers from Evora to Faro, aiming to take those neutral villages next turn.\nNo movements were made toward Badajoz due to insufficient strength.
A.plano:
Next turn we expect to capture Coimbra and Faro with the incoming spearmen and archers.
Build spearmen in Lisboa to replenish forces.
Avoid attacking Badajoz until we have stronger knight forces.
Keep garrisons at home.

A.depoimento: This turn we built spearmen in Lisboa, Santarem, and Evora to stockpile forces. We sent a single spearman from Coimbra to Porto and a single archer from Faro to Badajoz to probe and weaken the enemy garrisons. Our marching spearman from Lisboa continues toward Coimbra.
A.plano: Next turn we expect Porto and Badajoz to be weakened by our sacrificial attacks. Fresh spearmen from Lisboa will arrive at Coimbra and Faro to reinforce. We will then launch stronger assaults to capture these neutrals. Keep Lisboa producing troops for future pushes.

B.depoimento: We launch a double pronged attack on the neutral villages of Castellon and Huesca to expand our territory and secure resources. Our spearman and archers from Tarragona overwhelm Castellon, while our knights and archers from Girona crush Huesca's spearmen. We also begin building spearman in all our villages to grow our army.
B.plano: Attack Castellon with all troops from Tarragona. Attack Huesca with all troops from Girona. Build spearman in all three villages to reinforce. Next turn, consolidate the new villages and explore the road network to find the enemy.

A.depoimento: We trained fresh troops and sent a knight from Lisboa toward Badajoz, aiming to capture the neutral village and expand our realm.
A.plano: Next turn we expect Badajoz to fall after two turns, raising our held villages to six. We will continue producing spearmen for future assaults on Porto and Sevilha, and begin archers for those targets. Reinforce Coimbra to prepare a spearman push against Salamanca.

B.depoimento: We attacked Zaragoza from Huesca and Valencia from Castellon with all available troops. We reinforced our borders by sending troops from Barcelona to Tarragona, Girona to Huesca, and Tarragona to Castellon. We built new spearman in Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona to expand our army.
B.plano: Consolidate Zaragoza and Valencia next turn. Reinforce them from Tarragona and Huesca. Build spearman in all villages with resources. Explore the road network to find the enemy capital and other enemy villages. Prepare to attack Teruel or Pamplona.

A.depoimento: Turn 5: We marched from Lisboa with six spearmen and three knights, captured Porto after a decisive victory. Meanwhile, we ordered spearman production in Santarem, Evora, Coimbra and Faro to stockpile for future offensives.
A.plano: Next turn we will hold Porto and continue building spearmen in our interior villages. We will reinforce Coimbra to prepare a spearman assault on Salamanca. Avoid splitting forces; keep armies united for strong attacks.

B.depoimento: Our armies march on Teruel and Madrid. We claim these neutral lands to strengthen our kingdom. The spearman of Tarragona and the mixed force of Zaragoza lead the assault, while our villages produce troops for the next phase of expansion.
B.plano: Capture Teruel with Tarragona's 8 spearman and Madrid with Zaragoza's archers/knights. Build spearman in all villages to reinforce. Next turn, assess losses and consider attacks on Murcia and Pamplona. Explore westward from Madrid to find enemy villages.

B.depoimento: I am building up my forces across all villages. The 8 spearmen from Tarragona are about to capture Teruel, and I am sending reinforcements from Valencia and Castellon to secure it. I am also moving troops from Huesca to Zaragoza to prepare for the assault on Madrid, which will open the path to the western lands.
B.plano: Build 2 spearman in all villages to reinforce the home garrisons. Send 6 spearman from Huesca to Zaragoza to prepare for the assault on Madrid. Send 6 spearman from Valencia and 6 from Castellon to Teruel to secure it after the 8 spearmen from Tarragona capture it. Next turn, attack Madrid from Zaragoza and push west from Teruel to explore and conquer new territories.

A.depoimento: Ordered archers and spearmen across the realm, and sent Porto's spearmen and knights to take Salamanca. Hope to secure a new village next turn.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca this turn with Porto's force. Build archers in Faro, Porto, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra for future attacks on Vigo/Sevilha. Build spearmen in Lisboa and Badajoz for defense and future knight neutrals. Keep minimal garrison at Porto.

B.depoimento: This turn, my armies strike at the neutral strongholds of Madrid and Toledo. From Zaragoza, ten spearmen march on Madrid, while eleven spearmen from Teruel assault Toledo. I reinforce my western flank by sending troops from Castellon and Valencia to Teruel, and from Huesca to Zaragoza. In the north, Barcelona reinforces Girona, and Tarragona reinforces Barcelona. I build new spearmen across my domains to sustain the campaign.
B.plano: Attack Madrid from Zaragoza and Toledo from Teruel with all available spearmen. Reinforce Zaragoza from Huesca, Teruel from Castellon and Valencia, Girona from Barcelona, Barcelona from Tarragona. Build spearman everywhere possible. Next turn, consolidate gains and push towards Burgos and Salamanca.

B.depoimento: This turn, we focus on consolidation and reinforcement. I have ordered the construction of troops across our realm, including a knight in Barcelona, and the movement of all available forces from our interior villages to the border cities of Madrid and Toledo. By concentrating our strength at the front, we will be ready to strike at the neutral and enemy villages next turn and expand our territory.
B.plano: Build spearman in all interior villages and 1 knight in Barcelona. Send all available troops from interior villages to the borders: Tarragona to Zaragoza, Barcelona to Tarragona, Girona to Barcelona, Zaragoza to Madrid, Huesca to Zaragoza, Teruel to Toledo, Valencia to Teruel. This concentrates our forces on Madrid and Toledo to launch attacks on Burgos, Cordoba, Salamanca, and Badajoz next turn. Do not attack this turn as our current forces are too weak to overcome the village defenses.

A.depoimento: Built troops across the realm, sent five archers from Faro to take Sevilha, and marched spearmen to strengthen Badajoz and Salamanca.
A.plano: Capture Sevilha with archers next turn; reinforce Badajoz and Salamanca for future pushes. Avoid attacking Toledo/Madrid now due to weak force. Keep home garrisons sufficient.

B.depoimento: This turn, I built a mix of spearman and archers across my villages to diversify my army. I moved all available troops from interior villages to the border cities of Madrid and Toledo, preparing for an attack on the enemy. I did not attack yet, wanting to ensure we have a strong force.
B.plano: Building a mix of spearman and archers in all villages. Moving all interior troops to Madrid and Toledo. Do not attack this turn. Next turn, assess forces and consider attacking Salamanca with the concentrated troops, using archers to counter their spearman.

A.depoimento: Today we reinforced Badajoz with archers from our interior villages and trained new archers there. Our forces gather for a future strike on Toledo. No attack launched yet.
A.plano: Stockpile archers at Badajoz for attack on Toledo. Send archers from Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Faro, Salamanca, Sevilha. Build 6 archers in Badajoz. Next turn, launch attack with archers and spearmen.

B.depoimento: I have ordered the assault on Burgos and Cordoba, using the strength of Madrid and Toledo. Reinforcements are marching to our border cities, and our forges are burning to produce more archers and knights for the next phase of the campaign.
B.plano: This turn we attack Burgos and Cordoba with Madrid and Toledo forces. We send all available troops to reinforce Madrid and Toledo from interior villages. We build archers and knights to prepare for next attacks. Next turn, check battle results and decide on attacks against Murcia and Pamplona. Do not send more troops to the attacked villages until we know the outcome.

A.depoimento:
Built archers in nine villages to boost production.
Sent a mixed detachment from Badajoz to assault Toledo.
Sent a single archer from Porto to probe Vigo.
A.plano:
Capture Toledo next turn with a mixed force from Badajoz.
Stockpile archers in all villages for future reinforcements.
Keep sufficient garrison at home to defend against enemy probes.
Do not split forces unnecessarily.

B.depoimento: I have launched a massive three-pronged assault on the enemy's vulnerable territories: Sevilha, Vigo, and Salamanca. My armies are marching from Cordoba, Burgos, and Madrid with all available forces. In my rear, I am building knights in every village to strengthen my army for the next phase of the campaign. Reinforcements are already on the march to the front lines.
B.plano: This turn we attack Sevilha, Vigo, and Salamanca with all available troops from Cordoba, Burgos, and Madrid. We build knights in all interior villages to prepare for the next wave. We send reinforcements from Zaragoza, Teruel, Tarragona, and Valencia to Madrid and Toledo. Next turn, check battle results and decide on attacks against Faro, Porto, and Coimbra. Do not attack Badajoz yet.

A.depoimento:
I ordered mass archer production across my realms and dispatched a strong archer contingent from Badajoz to seize Toledo.
We aim to expand our holdings and weaken King B's frontline.
A.plano: Sent 10 archers from Badajoz to Toledo to capture it. Monitor battle outcome and prepare reinforcements. Continue archer production in all villages. Keep garrisons sufficient for defense.

B.depoimento: We have consolidated our western territories by conquering Sevilha, Vigo, and Salamanca. Now, we turn our sights to the remaining enemy outposts. We are building a mighty cavalry force in our heartlands and sending our armies to surround and eliminate the enemy's last strongholds. The march to victory is underway, and we will not stop until the enemy capital falls or we rule 75% of the known world!
B.plano: This turn we build knights in all interior villages to prepare for the next wave. We send all troops from Vigo to attack and conquer Porto. We send reinforcements from Teruel to Valencia, and from Madrid to Zaragoza, to prepare for attacks on Murcia and Pamplona next turn. Next turn, we must conquer Murcia and Pamplona to reach 18 villages, and then hold them for the win. Do not attack Badajoz yet; keep defending Salamanca, Toledo, and Sevilha.

B.depoimento: Our armies have struck at Murcia, Pamplona, and Porto, aiming to bring our total to 18 villages. Reinforcements have been sent to our vulnerable borders, and we are building a strong knight force to secure our empire. If these attacks succeed, we will hold the majority of the map.
B.plano: This turn we attack Murcia, Pamplona, and Porto to immediately reach 18 villages. We send all troops from Valencia and Zaragoza to the neutrals, and knights from Salamanca to Porto. We reinforce Toledo from Madrid, Vigo from Burgos, and Sevilha from Cordoba. We build knights in most villages to prepare for next turn's defense and further expansion. Next turn, we must hold our new villages and be ready to counter enemy attacks.

A.depoimento: We trained spearmen in all our villages and launched a spearman strike from Coimbra, seizing Porto from the enemy.
A.plano: Consolidate hold on Porto, continue massing spearmen for next assault on Salamanca or Toledo. Keep watch on enemy movements and avoid overextending.

B.depoimento: We rush reinforcements to our vulnerable western borders, especially Porto, while conscripting troops across the kingdom. We brace for enemy counterattacks and aim to hold our 18 villages until victory.
B.plano: Reinforce Porto and other borders with all available troops. Build spearman and archers everywhere to thicken defenses. Keep Salamanca, Toledo, Sevilha strong. Do not attack enemy villages this turn; focus on surviving and preparing for a decisive push next turn.

B.depoimento: I ordered my armies to march from the interior to the borders, swelling the garrisons of Salamanca, Toledo, Porto, and Sevilha. In every village, I set the smiths to work, forging new spearheads, bows, and armor. My goal is to hold the 18 villages for a second consecutive turn and watch the enemy crumble.
B.plano: Reinforce borders with all available interior troops. Build replacements everywhere. Hold 18 villages for another turn to secure victory. Do not attack enemy villages yet; focus on defense and consolidation.
